props.title: How FunPlay Manufactures Playground Equipment
props.summaryText: A walk through our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, near Mumbai: how a playground goes from drawing to roto-moulded parts, steel frames, finishing, checks and dispatch.
props.author: rohan-mehta
props.imageAlt: Inside the FunPlay playground equipment factory in Vasai

takeaways.text: FunPlay designs and manufactures playground equipment in-house at a 45,000 sq ft facility in Vasai, near Mumbai.
Plastic parts are roto-moulded; steel frames are fabricated, galvanised and powder coated.
Every order is planned from CAD drawings before production starts.
Parts are checked before dispatch, and our own teams install across India.

faq.q: Where does FunPlay manufacture its playground equipment?
faq.a: At our own 45,000 sq ft facility in Vasai East, near Mumbai, Maharashtra, where we design, roto-mould plastic parts and fabricate steel frames.
Galvanised steel pipes with a powder-coat finish, roto-moulded UV-stabilised polyethylene parts, composite laminate panels and steel-reinforced play rope, with galvanised or stainless fixings.

faq.q: Can I visit the FunPlay factory?
faq.a: Yes. We are happy to show buyers, architects and committees around the factory. Contact our sales team to arrange a visit.
